fullDescription: A playful and friendly fintech dashboard style with a cartoony aesthetic. Features a soft sky blue theme, high-radius components (28px-32px), and a modular grid layout. Ideal for personal finance, bill splitting, social budgeting, and casual lifestyle apps. It utilizes a soft-glassmorphism approach for activity feeds and a high-contrast dark mode for data insights. Keywords: playful, friendly, sky blue, fintech, bill splitting, dashboard, rounded corners, glassmorphism, horizontal scroll, bento-inspired.

structured.summary: A friendly, cartoony financial dashboard featuring a light sky-blue color palette (#0ea5e9), ultra-rounded components, and distinct sections for quick actions, templates, group management, and spending insights. The UI uses soft drop shadows (shadow-md) and background blur effects for a modern, accessible feel.

style.description: The style is characterized by its soft, vibrant palette and high corner radii. Typography uses a sans-serif stack (Slate) with weights ranging from font-medium to font-extrabold to create a clear hierarchy. Colors are used semantically: #0ea5e9 for primary actions, #10b981 (emerald) for success/paid states, and #f59e0b (amber) for pending/warning states. Components use thick borders (border-slate-200) and soft background blurs (backdrop-blur-sm) to differentiate layers.
style.prompt: Create a UI with a playful, cartoony aesthetic. Background: #f0f9ff with large, low-opacity decorative blur circles in #0ea5e9, #10b981, and #f59e0b. Primary Color: #0ea5e9. Corner Radii: cards at 24px-32px, buttons at 16px-20px. Typography: Sans-serif (Slate/Inter); Headings: 24px font-extrabold, tracking-tight; Labels: 11px font-bold, uppercase, tracking-wider in #94a3b8. Spacing: 20px padding for main containers, 12px for internal elements. Shadows: soft multi-layered shadow-md. Interactions: active:scale(0.98) for all clickable cards and buttons with 150ms ease-in-out transitions.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scroll mobile dashboard featuring a persistent floating bottom navigation and a fixed header. Content is organized into semantic sections: Hero/Action card, horizontal groups list, vertical activity feed, and a dark-mode insights card.

prompts.prompt: Top-aligned header with 56px height. Left: 44px rounded-2xl icon box in #0ea5e9 next to a two-line title ('Brand Name' bold, 'Tagline' small). Right: Two 44px rounded-2xl white buttons with #cbd5e1 borders for notifications and profile.

Large white card (rounded-3xl) containing: 1) A currency selector pill (#f1f5f9 background, 11px font-bold). 2) Large headline with 24px extrabold text. 3) Two-column grid of primary buttons (one #0ea5e9 with white text, one white with #0ea5e9 icon). 4) Horizontal scroll area for templates with 52px rounded-2xl icon buttons and text labels. 5) Quick stats footer with small colored pill containers for different data points.

Section title 'Your Groups' (18px bold). Horizontal scroll container of cards (160px width). Each card: white background, rounded-3xl, 16px padding. Includes a top-left icon box (40px, rounded-xl) in varying pastel colors, bold group name, and small member count.

Vertical list of activity items. Each item: white background with 60% opacity, border-white/50, backdrop-blur-sm, 12px padding, rounded-2xl. Layout: 32px circle avatar, middle text area with bolded names/entities, and right-aligned timestamp (10px).

High-contrast dark card (bg: #0f172a, rounded-3xl). Header: Two-line text (label/value) and an 'Insights' ghost button. Body: Minimalist bar chart with 4 vertical bars. Active bar: #0ea5e9 with a glow effect (box-shadow: 0 0 15px #0ea5e9). Inactive bars: #1e293b. Future bars: dashed border with diagonal stripe pattern.

Fixed footer pill (bg: white, border-slate-200, shadow-xl, rounded-[28px]) with 4 grid items. Active state: #f0f9ff background with #0ea5e9 text/icon. Center item: 'Plus' icon inside a 44px #0ea5e9 rounded-2xl square box that breaks slightly above the label line.

special_ui_components.description: Small toggle pill for switching application currency.
special_ui_components.prompt: Button element: inline-flex, rounded-full, bg-slate-100, padding: 4px 8px 4px 12px. Inside: 16px white circle with centered text ('Rp'), followed by currency code ('IDR') in 11px font-bold, and a chevron-down icon.

special_ui_components.description: Contextual labels for payment or activity status.
special_ui_components.prompt: Capsule shape: rounded-full, text-size: 10px, font-bold, uppercase. Emerald version: bg-emerald-100, text-emerald-800. Amber version: bg-amber-100, text-amber-800. Padding: 4px 8px.

special_ui_components.description: Visual representation of group members or participants.
special_ui_components.prompt: Flex container with negative spacing (-8px). Individual circles: 28px diameter, border: 2px solid white. Backgrounds: varying pastel shades. Text: centered, 10px font-bold, dark slate color.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use specific font weights (800 for main titles, 400 for subtext). MUST: Maintain high border-radius consistency across all components. MUST: Use subtle background blur (backdrop-blur-sm) on white/60 surfaces for depth. DO NOT: Use sharp corners or harsh black shadows. DO NOT: Use high-contrast borders; keep them subtle (#e2e8f0).
